description: I want a ring of colorful LEDs I can control from my Arduino with just one wire, and I need to be able to chain multiple rings together.

16x WS2812B-V5 addressable RGB LEDs in ring layout, 5VDC supply, single-wire NZR protocol on DIN, 100nF 0402 bypass cap per LED on VDD-VSS, 3-pin JST-PH input (5V/DIN/GND) and 3-pin JST-PH output (5V/DOUT/GND) for daisy-chaining. ~18mA constant-current per LED channel.
I need a sensor that can tell me which way my robot is pointing in 3D space without me having to do any complicated math in my code.

Bosch BNO055 9-DoF IMU in LGA-28 5.2x3.8mm, on-chip Cortex-M0 sensor fusion outputting quaternions/Euler. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO, 32.768kHz crystal with 12pF 0402 load caps, 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD and VDDIO, 4.7K 0603 I2C pull-ups, 10K pull-ups on nRESET and INT, ADDR to GND for 0x28. Two JST-SH 4-pin STEMMA QT connectors, 1x7 2.54mm breakout header.
I want to measure how much power my project is using so I can figure out how long my battery will last.

TI INA219BxD high-side current/power monitor in SOIC-8, 12-bit ADC, I2C interface. 0.1 ohm 1% sense resistor in 2512 package for +/-3.2A range. 100nF 0603 + 10uF 0805 decoupling on VS. 10K 0603 I2C pull-ups on SDA/SCL. A0/A1 to GND for address 0x40. 1x6 2.54mm breakout header (VCC/GND/SCL/SDA/VIN+/VIN-).
I need a weather station sensor that can tell me the temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure from my microcontroller project.

Bosch BME280 environmental sensor in LGA-8 2.5x2.5mm, I2C/SPI interface. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 input/output caps and 100nF 0603 output filter. 10K 0603 I2C pull-ups on SDA/SCL. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD and VDDIO. SDO to GND for I2C address 0x76. 1x6 2.54mm breakout header (VIN/GND/SCL/SDA/SDO/CS).
I need a really accurate temperature sensor for my Arduino project that I can put several of on the same bus.

Microchip MCP9808 digital temperature sensor in MSOP-8, +/-0.25C accuracy, I2C interface. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD. 10K 0603 pull-ups on SDA/SCL, 10K 0603 pull-downs on A0/A1/A2 address pins (default 0x18). Alert output open-drain active-low. 2.7-5.5V supply. 1x6 2.54mm breakout header.
I want a small development board I can program like an Arduino but with built-in battery charging for portable projects.

ATSAMD21G18A QFP-48, 48MHz Cortex-M0+, 256KB flash, 32KB RAM, native USB. MCP73831 SOT-23-5 LiPo charger with 2K PROG resistor (500mA), JST-PH 2-pin battery connector. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 input/output caps. Schottky diode for USB/battery auto-switching. Battery voltage divider (100K/100K) to ADC. 32.768kHz crystal with load caps. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12 at 2.54mm pitch.
I want to control multiple DC motors and stepper motors from my Arduino without using up all my pins.

PCA9685PW I2C 16-channel PWM driver (TSSOP-28) controlling 2x TB6612FNG dual H-bridge drivers (SSOP-24, 1.2A continuous, 3A peak). 5 address-select pins (A0-A4) for I2C address configuration, stackable up to 32 shields. P-MOSFET reverse polarity protection on motor power input. 220 ohm series resistors on PWM outputs. 10K I2C pull-ups, 100nF + 10uF decoupling per IC. Arduino shield form factor headers.
I want to play music files from an SD card through a speaker using my Arduino, and maybe make some MIDI sounds too.

VLSI VS1053B audio codec in LQFP-48, 12.288MHz crystal with load caps. Decodes MP3/AAC/Ogg/WMA/MIDI/FLAC/WAV, records PCM and Ogg Vorbis. 1.8V internal core regulator with external 10uF + 100nF caps, 3.3V I/O supply. SPI interface with DREQ/xCS/xDCS/xRESET. MicroSD card slot (SPI). 3.5mm stereo headphone jack with 10uF coupling caps. Electret mic input with 2.2K bias resistor. 8 GPIO pins on header. MIDI UART input at 31250 baud.
I need to generate precise clock signals at different frequencies for my radio or test equipment project.

Silicon Labs Si5351A-B-GT MSOP-10 I2C clock generator with 25MHz crystal reference and 10pF 0402 load caps. Three independent outputs (CLK0/CLK1/CLK2) from 8kHz to 160MHz, 3Vpp. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 + 100nF 0603 caps. BSS138 SOT-23 bidirectional I2C level shifter with 10K 0402 pull-ups on both sides. SMA connector on CLK0 for RF. 1x7 2.54mm breakout header, 1x2 headers per clock output.
I want to play digital audio from my microcontroller through a speaker without needing a separate DAC board.

Maxim MAX98357A I2S Class-D mono amplifier in QFN-16 2x2mm, 3.2W into 4 ohm at 5V. I2S input (DIN/BCLK/LRCLK), 2.7-5.5V supply. Ferrite bead on VDD input, 10uF 0805 + 100nF 0603 decoupling. GAIN pin resistor network for 3/6/9/12/15dB selection. SD_MODE enable pin with 1M pull-down. 2-pin screw terminal for speaker output. 1x7 2.54mm input header (VIN/GND/DIN/BCLK/LRCLK/GAIN/SD).
I want a small portable board with the Raspberry Pi chip that I can program with CircuitPython and plug into battery power.

RP2040 QFN-56 7x7mm dual Cortex-M0+ at 133MHz, 264KB SRAM. GD25Q64 8MB QSPI flash SOIC-8. 12MHz crystal with 15pF 0402 load caps. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 caps. MCP73831 SOT-23-5 LiPo charger with 2K PROG resistor, JST-PH battery connector. USB-C with 5.1K CC pull-downs. WS2812B NeoPixel with 100nF bypass. 1uF DVDD decoupling, 100nF 0402 per IOVDD bank. STEMMA QT JST-SH 4-pin. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12.
I'm looking for an all-in-one board to teach kids programming and electronics without any soldering or wiring.

ATSAMD21G18A TQFP-48 at 48MHz, 256KB flash, 32KB RAM. 10x WS2812B NeoPixels in ring layout. LIS3DH accelerometer (LGA-16, I2C), SPW2430 MEMS microphone, mini speaker with Class-D amp, IR transmitter LED + IR receiver (TSOP38238), ALS-PT19 light sensor with 10K load resistor, thermistor for temperature. 2 tactile buttons, slide switch. MCP73831 LiPo charger. AP2112K-3.3 LDO. USB Micro-B. JST-PH battery connector. 8 capacitive-touch alligator-clip pads, 3.3V/GND pads.
I want to build a custom shortcut keyboard with a knob and a small screen that I can program to do whatever I want.

RP2040 QFN-56 with W25Q64JV 8MB QSPI flash SOIC-8, 12MHz crystal, 15pF load caps. USB-C with 5.1K 0402 CC pull-downs. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO. 12x Cherry MX key sockets (direct GPIO, not matrix), 12x WS2812B NeoPixels daisy-chained with 100nF bypass per 4. Alps EC11 rotary encoder with 10K 0402 pull-ups. SH1106 128x64 OLED on hardware SPI. PAM8302A SOIC-8 Class-D amp with RC input filter driving 8mm speaker. STEMMA QT JST-SH with 2.2K 0402 I2C pull-ups. 1uF DVDD, 100nF 0402 per IOVDD bank.
I need a small WiFi and Bluetooth board with battery support that I can program with Python for IoT projects.

ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 module (dual 240MHz, WiFi/BLE, 8MB flash, 512KB SRAM). Native USB on IO19/IO20. USB-C with 5.1K 0402 CC pull-downs. MCP73831 SOT-23-5 LiPo charger (2K PROG, 500mA). LC709203FQH-01TWG DFN-8 battery fuel gauge with 10K NTC thermistor. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 100K enable pull-up. AO3401A SOT-23 P-FET for switchable STEMMA QT power. 4.7K 0402 I2C pull-ups. WS2812B NeoPixel. 32.768kHz crystal with 6.8pF load caps. W25Q64JV 8MB SPI flash. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12. JST-PH battery connector.
I want a board with WiFi and Bluetooth that works like an Arduino but can connect to the internet for home automation.

ESP32-WROOM-32 module (dual-core 240MHz, WiFi/BT, 4MB SPI flash, PCB antenna). CP2104 QFN-24 USB-to-UART bridge with auto-reset circuit (DTR/RTS via transistors to EN/IO0). MCP73831 SOT-23-5 LiPo charger with JST-PH battery connector. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 caps. Schottky diode for USB/battery switching. NeoPixel status LED. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12 at 2.54mm. 100nF + 10uF decoupling on 3.3V rail.
I need the biggest Arduino-compatible board possible with tons of pins for a complex project with lots of sensors and motors.

Microchip ATSAMD51P20A TQFP-128, 120MHz Cortex-M4F with FPU/DSP, 1MB flash, 256KB RAM. 8MB QSPI flash (GD25Q64) with 100nF decoupling. MicroSD card slot (SPI). Dual 12-bit DAC, dual 1MSPS ADC (15 analog inputs). 8x SERCOM, 22x PWM, I2S, AES-256, TRNG. AP2112K-3.3 LDO from 5V rail. 7805-compatible regulator for 6-12V DC barrel jack input with power switch. USB Micro-B with native USB. WS2812B NeoPixel. Arduino Mega form factor headers. 32.768kHz + 12MHz crystals with load caps.
I want a touchscreen display I can program with Python to show weather, news, or other internet data on my desk.

ATSAMD51J20 TQFP-64, 120MHz Cortex-M4F, 1MB flash, 256KB RAM, native USB. ESP32-WROOM-32 WiFi coprocessor (SPI + UART bridge). 3.2-inch 320x240 ILI9341 TFT with resistive touchscreen (TSC2007 I2C controller). ADT7410 I2C temperature sensor (SOT-23). ALS-PT19 analog light sensor. 8MB SPI flash (GD25Q64). MicroSD slot. WS2812B NeoPixel. Mini speaker with Class-D amp. AP2112K-3.3 LDO. I2C STEMMA port, 2x analog/digital JST ports. USB Micro-B.
I want a Bluetooth board with a bunch of built-in sensors so I can make a wearable fitness or environmental monitor without adding extra boards.

Nordic nRF52840 QFN-56 at 64MHz Cortex-M4F, 1MB flash, 256KB SRAM, BLE 5.0. Sensors: LSM6DS33 LGA-14 accel/gyro + LIS3MDL LGA-12 magnetometer (9-DoF), APDS9960 proximity/light/color/gesture, SPW2430 PDM MEMS microphone, SHT30 DFN-8 humidity, BMP280 LGA-8 barometric pressure. USB-C with 5.1K CC pull-downs. MCP73831 LiPo charger. AP2112K-3.3 LDO. 32.768kHz crystal with load caps. 4.7K I2C pull-ups. WS2812B NeoPixel. STEMMA QT JST-SH. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12. FCC/IC/TELEC certified.
I want a faster Arduino board that can run CircuitPython and is compatible with all my existing Arduino shields.

Microchip ATSAMD51J19A TQFP-64, 120MHz Cortex-M4F with FPU, 512KB flash, 192KB RAM. 8MB QSPI flash (GD25Q64). 8MHz HSE crystal, 32.768kHz LSE crystal with load caps. AP2112K-3.3 LDO from 5V. 7-12V DC barrel jack with 5V switching regulator. USB Micro-B native USB with UF2 bootloader. WS2812B NeoPixel. 100nF decoupling per power bank. Arduino Metro/Uno-compatible shield headers with SPI/I2C/UART in standard positions.
I want a sensor board with a color screen that fits BBC micro:bit accessories and I can program with Python.

Nordic nRF52840 QFN-56, 64MHz Cortex-M4F, 1MB flash, 256KB SRAM, BLE 5.0. 1.3-inch 240x240 ST7789 IPS TFT (SPI). Sensors: LSM6DS33 accel/gyro + LIS3MDL magnetometer, APDS9960 gesture/proximity/color, SPW2430 PDM mic, SHT30 humidity, BMP280 pressure. 2MB external SPI flash. WS2812B NeoPixel, buzzer with Class-D amp, 2x white LEDs for illumination. STEMMA QT JST-SH I2C, 4.7K pull-ups. USB-C. AP2112K-3.3 LDO. BBC micro:bit edge connector (80-pin card-edge) with 5 large pads. 3-6V battery input.
I want to read multiple analog sensors more precisely than my Arduino's built-in ADC can manage.

TI ADS1115IDGS 16-bit I2C ADC with PGA in TSSOP-10. 10K 0603 pull-ups on SDA/SCL and ALERT/RDY (open-drain). ADDR to GND via 0R for I2C address 0x48. 100nF 0603 + 10uF 0805 decoupling on VDD. 4 analog inputs (AIN0-AIN3). Two JST-SH 4-pin STEMMA QT connectors. 1x10 2.54mm breakout header (VDD/GND/SCL/SDA/ADDR/ALERT/A0-A3).
I need a sensor that can detect colors accurately for a sorting machine or art project.

AMS TCS34725 RGBC color sensor in DFN-6 2x2.2mm, I2C interface at 0x29. IR-blocking filter integrated. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO. White LED illuminator with FET switch for control. 10K 0603 I2C pull-ups on SDA/SCL. 100nF 0603 + 1uF 0402 decoupling on VDD. INT output open-drain with 10K pull-up. 1x7 2.54mm breakout header (VIN/GND/SCL/SDA/INT/LED/3V3).
I want to add touch-sensitive buttons or pads to my project without mechanical switches, maybe on fruit or foil.

NXP MPR121QR2 capacitive touch controller in QFN-20 3x3mm, 12 independent touch electrodes, I2C interface. 3.3V-only chip with AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO and BSS138 I2C level shifter for 3-5V host compatibility. 10K pull-ups on SDA/SCL (3.3V side). ADDR pin with 4 selectable addresses (up to 48 pads on bus). IRQ output with LED indicator and 10K pull-up. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD. 1x12 touch pad header, 1x6 I2C/power header.
I want to measure altitude or air pressure for a weather station or drone project using my Arduino.

Bosch BMP180 barometric pressure sensor in LGA-7 3.6x3.8mm, I2C interface at 0x77. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO from 5V with 10uF 0805 + 100nF 0603 caps. BSS138 SOT-23 I2C level shifter with 10K pull-ups on both sides for 3-5V logic. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD. 1x5 2.54mm breakout header (VIN/GND/SCL/SDA/3V3).
I need a sensor that can detect tilt and compass direction for a navigation or orientation project.

ST LSM303DLHC 6-DoF accelerometer/magnetometer in LGA-14 3x5mm, dual I2C addresses (0x19 accel, 0x1E mag). AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF + 100nF caps. 10K 0603 I2C pull-ups. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD and VDD_IO. INT1/INT2/DRDY outputs with 10K pull-ups. 1x8 2.54mm breakout header (VIN/GND/SCL/SDA/DRDY/INT1/INT2/3V3).
I need a small board that can measure ambient light levels and connect to my microcontroller's analog input.

ALS-PT19 NPN phototransistor in 1206 reverse-mount package, collector to VCC via 10K 0603 load resistor, emitter to GND. Analog output at collector node (0-VCC proportional to light). 100nF 0603 decoupling on VCC, 100nF 0603 RC filter on analog output. 1x3 2.54mm header (VCC/GND/AOUT). No regulator, direct 3.3-5V operation.
I want a basic Arduino-compatible board for learning electronics and running simple projects with shields.

Microchip ATmega328P TQFP-32 at 16MHz, 32KB flash, 2KB SRAM, 1KB EEPROM. CP2104 QFN-24 USB-to-serial converter. 16MHz crystal with 22pF load caps. AP2112K-3.3 LDO for 3.3V output. 5V barrel jack (7-12V) with LM7805 or NCP1117 5V regulator. Polarity protection diode on DC input. 4x status LEDs (power, RX, TX, L13). 10K pull-up on RESET with 100nF cap. Arduino Uno-compatible headers with SPI/I2C/UART. 6-pin ICSP header.
I need the tiniest possible programmable board to embed inside a small project like a wearable LED or a toy.

Microchip ATtiny85 SOIC-8 at 8MHz (3.3V version) or 16MHz (5V version). Bitbang USB via 68 ohm series resistors + 3.6V zener clamp on D+/D-. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO (3.3V variant). Power LED + GPIO13 LED with current-limiting resistors. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VCC. Micro-USB connector. 5 GPIO pins broken out on 2.54mm header. Reset button.
I want a sensor that can tell me the air quality in a room along with temperature and humidity for a smart home project.

Bosch BME680 environmental sensor in LGA-8 3x3mm with temperature/humidity/pressure/VOC gas sensing, I2C and SPI interfaces. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO from 3.3-5V input. TXB0104 TSSOP-14 bidirectional level shifter for I2C/SPI lines. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD, VDDIO, and regulator output. 10uF 0805 bulk caps on regulator I/O. 1x6 2.54mm header (VIN/GND/SCL/SDA/SDO/CSB).
I need a clock module that keeps accurate time even when my Arduino is powered off, for data logging or alarm projects.

Maxim DS3231M TCXO RTC in SOIC-16W, +/-2 ppm accuracy (2 min/year). CR2032 coin cell battery backup holder. I2C interface at 0x68. 4.7K 0603 pull-ups on SDA/SCL. 10K pull-up on INT/SQW (open-drain, active-low). 32KHz output with 10K pull-up. 100nF 0603 + 10uF 0805 decoupling on VCC. Power LED with 1K series resistor. 1x7 2.54mm I2C/power header, 1x4 alarm/output header.
I need to measure temperature very precisely using a platinum sensor for a scientific or industrial application.

Maxim MAX31865 RTD-to-digital converter in TSSOP-20, 15-bit ADC, SPI interface. Supports 2/3/4-wire PT100 RTD with automatic wire resistance compensation. 4.3K reference resistor (Rref) for PT100 range. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD and AVDD. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO. 0.1uF filter caps on RTD inputs. Solder jumpers for 2/3/4-wire configuration. 1x7 2.54mm SPI header (VIN/GND/CLK/SDO/SDI/CS/RDY). Screw terminal for RTD connection.
I want to measure really high temperatures like in an oven or kiln using a thermocouple probe with my microcontroller.

Maxim MAX31856 thermocouple-to-digital converter in TSSOP-14, 19-bit ADC, SPI interface. Supports K/J/N/R/S/T/E/B thermocouple types with cold-junction compensation. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO from 5V input. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD and AVDD. 10nF bias filter caps on T+/T- inputs. 10K pull-ups on DRDY and FAULT outputs. 1x7 2.54mm SPI header. 2-pin screw terminal for thermocouple wires.
I want to control a grid of LEDs individually for scrolling text or simple animations from my microcontroller.

ISSI IS31FL3731 PWM LED driver in QFN-28 4x4mm, charlieplex matrix driving 16x9 (144) LEDs with individual 8-bit PWM brightness. I2C interface, AD pin for address selection (up to 4 drivers, addresses 0x74-0x77). 8 frames of display memory for animation. R_EXT 20K resistor for LED current setting (~10mA). C_FILT 1uF capacitor for internal charge pump. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VCC. Two STEMMA QT JST-SH 4-pin connectors. SDB shutdown pin with 10K pull-up.
I want to connect a large color touchscreen display to my Arduino without using a lot of pins or processing power.

RAiO RA8875 TFT controller in LQFP-100, 768KB on-chip display RAM, hardware shape drawing and built-in fonts. SPI host interface up to 20MHz. 40-pin FPC connector for parallel TFT panels up to 800x480. Built-in 4-wire resistive touchscreen controller. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO. 20MHz crystal with load caps. 100nF decoupling on all VDD/AVDD pins (6+ caps). Backlight driver MOSFET with PWM control. 1x10 2.54mm SPI/control header. INT and WAIT outputs with pull-ups.
I need to control a bunch of servos for a robot arm or animatronic project without using up all my microcontroller pins.

NXP PCA9685PW I2C 16-channel 12-bit PWM driver in TSSOP-28. 6 address pins (A0-A5) for up to 62 devices on one bus. 25MHz internal oscillator, adjustable PWM frequency 24-1526Hz. Open-drain outputs with 220 ohm 0603 series resistors. 10K I2C pull-ups on SDA/SCL. 100nF 0603 + 10uF 0805 decoupling. Reverse polarity protection P-MOSFET on V+ servo power. OE (output enable) with 10K pull-down. 4x3 pin servo headers (signal/V+/GND). Chainable I2C headers.
I want a small amp board to make my microcontroller project play sounds through a speaker, louder than just a buzzer.

PAM8302A Class-D mono amplifier in SOP-8, 2.5W into 4 ohm at 5V, 90% efficiency. Fully differential inputs (IN+/IN-). 2.0-5.5V supply. 10K trimmer potentiometer for volume control. 1uF input coupling capacitor. 100nF + 10uF decoupling on VDD. SD (shutdown) pin with 100K pull-up (always on). 2-pin screw terminal for speaker. 1x5 2.54mm input header (VIN/GND/A+/A-/SD).
I want to connect sensors and chips directly to my computer's USB port without needing a separate microcontroller board.

FTDI FT232H USB-to-multi-protocol bridge in LQFP-48. 12MHz crystal with load caps. 93C46 EEPROM SOIC-8 for device configuration. USB-C connector with ESD protection. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO from USB 5V. 1.8V internal core regulator with external 100nF + 4.7uF caps. Ferrite beads on USB VBUS and analog supply. Status LEDs (power/TX/RX) with 1K series resistors. 10K pull-up on nRESET. 100nF decoupling per VCC pin. 2x13 2.54mm breakout headers for all GPIO/protocol pins.
I need to safely connect my 3.3V sensor to my 5V Arduino without damaging anything.

4x BSS138 N-channel MOSFET SOT-23 bidirectional level shifters. 10K 0603 pull-up resistors on both low-voltage (LV) and high-voltage (HV) sides per channel. 2-pin power headers for LV (1.8-3.3V) and HV (3.3-5V) reference voltages. 100nF 0603 decoupling on both supply rails. 2x6 2.54mm through-hole header (LV1-LV4/LV/GND on one side, HV1-HV4/HV/GND on other).
I want a beginner-friendly board that runs CircuitPython right out of the box with battery power for portable projects.

ATSAMD21G18A TQFP-48, 48MHz Cortex-M0+, 256KB flash, 32KB RAM. GD25Q16 2MB SPI flash SOIC-8 for CircuitPython filesystem. WS2812B NeoPixel status LED on PA06 with 100nF bypass. MCP73831 SOT-23-5 LiPo charger with 2K PROG resistor. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 caps. USB Micro-B with UF2 bootloader. 32.768kHz crystal with load caps. Schottky diode auto-switching USB/battery. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12. JST-PH battery connector.
I need a fast portable board for CircuitPython that can handle more demanding projects like audio processing or machine learning.

Microchip ATSAMD51J19A TQFP-64, 120MHz Cortex-M4F with FPU, 512KB flash, 192KB RAM. GD25Q16 2MB SPI flash SOIC-8. 8MHz HSE crystal with load caps, 32.768kHz LSE crystal. MCP73831 SOT-23-5 LiPo charger. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 caps. USB Micro-B native USB. WS2812B NeoPixel. 100nF per VDDCORE/VDDIO bank. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12. JST-PH battery connector. NeoPixel on PA06.
I want the smallest possible board that I can plug sensors into without soldering for quick prototyping.

ATSAMD21E18A TQFP-32, 48MHz Cortex-M0+, 256KB flash, 32KB RAM. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO from USB 5V. USB-C connector with 5.1K CC pull-downs. WS2812B NeoPixel (RGB). Reset button (tactile). STEMMA QT JST-SH 4-pin I2C connector with 10K pull-ups. Optional SOIC-8 SPI flash pads on bottom. Seeed Xiao-compatible castellated pad pinout, 11 GPIO. 100nF 0603 decoupling on VDD/VDDCORE. 32.768kHz crystal.
I want a tiny but powerful board I can use with CircuitPython for small embedded projects and sensor reading.

RP2040 QFN-56 7x7mm dual Cortex-M0+ at 125MHz, 264KB SRAM. W25Q64JV 8MB QSPI flash SOIC-8. 12MHz crystal with 15pF 0402 load caps. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO from USB 5V. USB-C with 5.1K 0402 CC pull-downs. WS2812B NeoPixel (RGB). Boot button + reset button. STEMMA QT JST-SH 4-pin I2C with 10K pull-ups. 1uF DVDD decoupling, 100nF 0402 per IOVDD bank. Seeed Xiao-compatible castellated pad pinout, 13 GPIO.
I want to build a custom mechanical keyboard with fancy RGB lighting that I can program with Python.

RP2040 QFN-56 7x7mm dual Cortex-M0+ at 133MHz, 264KB SRAM. W25Q64JV 8MB QSPI flash SOIC-8. 12MHz crystal with 15pF 0402 load caps. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO. USB-C with 5.1K CC pull-downs. WS2812B NeoPixel. STEMMA QT JST-SH 4-pin I2C port with 10K pull-ups. Castellated pads for direct PCB soldering, Pro Micro-compatible pinout. 2x 1x13 2.54mm headers, 20+ GPIO for keyboard matrix. 1uF DVDD decoupling, 100nF 0402 per IOVDD bank.
I need a low-power WiFi board with native USB for battery-powered IoT sensor nodes that run for a long time.

ESP32-S2-WROVER module (single-core 240MHz, WiFi, 4MB flash, 2MB PSRAM). Native USB on GPIO19/20. USB-C with 5.1K CC pull-downs. MCP73831 SOT-23-5 LiPo charger. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 caps. WS2812B NeoPixel. STEMMA QT JST-SH 4-pin I2C with switchable power (P-MOSFET). 4.7K I2C pull-ups. 32.768kHz crystal with load caps. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12. JST-PH battery connector.
I want an Arduino-compatible board in the small Feather size with battery charging for simple portable projects.

Microchip ATmega328P TQFP-32 at 8MHz/3.3V. CP2104 QFN-24 USB-to-serial converter. 8MHz crystal with 22pF load caps. MCP73831 SOT-23-5 LiPo charger with JST-PH battery connector. AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO with 10uF 0805 caps. Schottky diode USB/battery auto-switching. Battery voltage divider to ADC. 100nF decoupling on VCC/AVCC. 10K pull-up on RESET. Feather headers 1x16 + 1x12 at 2.54mm.
